What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/b80c73d10b0d6b581d17384bfd875038aa3a3c02fb997ccd7680150fb1ed2193.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-3,1).$
